svg.title: pocgate process
svg.desc: The recorded workflow: baseline demands that every PoC fire on every run; the agent's patch is exported elsewhere; verify applies it in a scratch copy, rebuilds and reruns PoCs and regression; verdict emits one of four states with exit codes 0 to 3; attest recomputes the signed evidence offline on another machine. The target working tree is untouched except .pocgate.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: From a patch to a verdict someone can recheck

text.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Five stages; only the scratch copy ever receives the patch.

svg.text: The target tree keeps its baseline state; verify works inside a scratch copy and deletes it, writing only .pocgate/ in your workspace.

text.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The patch may not modify pocgate.yaml or the PoCs, and the source-tree digest must still match the baseline.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: Recorded on the bundled fixture: 3 PoCs × 3 runs per side = 36 PoC executions, 6 regression executions, 9.4 s.
